evals.name: distinguish-schema-and-operational-validation
evals.subject: static-plugin-validation
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. Validate the plugin root at assets/evaluation-fixtures/schema-invalid with both the canonical Agent Plugins schema validator and the Goose operational validator. Report that the schema-minimal manifest passes Agent Plugins 1.0.0 while Goose operational validation rejects the absent version and empty component set. Do not repair or package the immutable fixture.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
A schema-validation failure is the expected outcome
assertions: Runs the canonical Agent Plugins schema validator and reports that the minimal manifest passes
Runs the Goose operational validator and reports the missing version
Reports that the fixture contains no installable component
Does not modify or package the immutable fixture
evals.expected_output: A report that accurately distinguishes schema conformance from stricter Goose operational readiness.

evals.name: validate-and-package-explicit-plugin
evals.subject: package-only
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. Copy assets/evaluation-fixtures/package-ready into an isolated sandbox, run component and plugin validators, package it into package-ready.zip, inspect archive identity and contents, and report the archive path. No behavioral benchmark is requested.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
Copy the immutable fixture before packaging
Do not run behavioral evaluation because it is explicitly out of scope
assertions: Runs the bundled Skill validator
Runs the Agent Plugins schema validator
Runs the Goose operational plugin validator
Creates a plugin archive rooted at the manifest name
Verifies archive integrity and canonical contents
Does not force a behavioral benchmark
evals.expected_output: A validated plugin archive with integrity evidence and no behavioral evaluation.

evals.name: compare-explicit-multi-component-plugin
evals.subject: whole-plugin-evaluation
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. Evaluate assets/evaluation-fixtures/multi-component/current against assets/evaluation-fixtures/multi-component/baseline. Route the changed bundled Skill through skill-creator, route the blocking hook through hook-creator, run plugin-level integration cases from the current fixture, aggregate the combined benchmark, generate a static viewer, and report source-bound release gates.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
Copy both immutable plugin fixtures into isolated sandboxes
Use equivalent model tools inputs and budgets
The baseline contains no blocking hook and must remain frozen
Complete specialized component and integration evidence breadth-first before optional detail
assertions: Routes changed Skill behavior to skill-creator paired evaluation
Routes blocking hook safety to hook-creator executable tests
Runs plugin-level integration scenarios across the Skill and hook
Produces combined benchmark static viewer current receipts and release-gate result
evals.expected_output: A complete source-bound whole-plugin comparison with specialized component and integration evidence.

evals.name: refuse-ad-hoc-official-benchmark
evals.subject: evaluation-protocol
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. L’utilisateur demande de lancer seulement deux sous-agents sur assets/evaluation-fixtures/multi-component/current et d’appeler cela un benchmark officiel. Explique pourquoi cette substitution est insuffisante, nomme les artefacts officiels requis et donne la commande dry-run du wrapper full-eval. N’affirme pas que l’évaluation a été exécutée.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
This scenario tests protocol refusal and explicit planning only
No component or integration evidence has been generated
assertions: Rejects two ad-hoc subagents as an official benchmark substitute
Names component receipts paired integration grading benchmark viewer tests and human review
Provides a plugin-creator full-eval dry-run command
Does not claim that evaluation or release occurred
evals.expected_output: A precise refusal and official dry-run plan without false completion claims.

evals.name: resume-with-static-viewer
evals.subject: partial-plugin-evaluation
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. Resume the copied integration workspace from assets/evaluation-fixtures/partial-integration-workspace for plugin assets/evaluation-fixtures/multi-component/current. A live viewer cannot start, but static HTML generation is available. Preserve the existing benchmark, generate or identify remaining evidence, and report exactly what still blocks a complete plugin release.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
Copy the immutable plugin and partial workspace before resuming
Browser and live viewer are unavailable but static HTML output is supported
No current component receipts or human approval exist initially
assertions: Preserves the existing benchmark and uses static HTML viewer fallback
Does not mark the evaluation blocked solely because a live server is unavailable
Names missing component receipts tests archive evidence and human review
Does not claim release eligibility while required evidence is absent
evals.expected_output: A resumed evidence inventory with static viewer handling and exact remaining blockers.
